claims: C1 the assistant is generally subject to hard limits on the number of tokens it can output per message
C2 the assistant should avoid producing incomplete responses that are interrupted by these limits

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: incomplete_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response that is incomplete, i.e. cut off before it is finished
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'incomplete responses'; the class is needed to state the avoidance

concepts.name: token_limit_interruption
concepts.gloss: R is a response that is interrupted by the hard token limit
concepts.inference: the clause says incomplete responses are interrupted by the limits; the class is needed to state the avoidance

concepts.name: produces
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of the assistant producing responses; the relation is needed to bind the act to the assistant

asserts.read_back: producing incomplete response % is forbidden because it is interrupted by the hard token limit

closure.reason: the clause says the assistant should avoid producing incomplete responses interrupted by the limits, so silence about such responses is not permission; the default is prohibition
